item.name: OpenCL C (.cl)
item.grammar_source: lefp/tree-sitter-opencl (candidate; compare maintained C before selection)
item.notes: Initial .cl-only OpenCL C target. Require a positive C/OpenCL sniff and Lisp/Cool negatives, keep every kernel and include fragment in tenancy, publish each subject separately, use reconstructed CL3.0 Clang AST at tier B. Native parse triage does not select or ship a grammar. Exclude C++ for OpenCL, embedded host strings and extra suffixes from this initial proposal. L3/L4 require their own oracle-backed measurements.

ordering: GLSL lands, then OpenCL C ships, then Slang starts
activation: The controller adds/proves the queue and plan rows; this file does not alter the canonical queue.
